releases.notes:
Development channel qualification candidate, 0.3.7-dev.1.

Firmware source differs from stable 0.3.6 only in its version declarations. Signed with the established production key for LilyGO T-Dongle-S3, layout link-v1.

Hardware checks completed: the local cloud example installed this exact image from stable 0.3.6 and returned to the exact stable 0.3.6 image. Both installations produced installed receipts and healthy-boot reports. Screen on, LED on, 180-degree orientation, and settings revision 6 were preserved. Cloud communication resumed.

This prerelease supports opt-in testing of the new channel selectors. Bridge download/install qualification is the next test. Machine preview and power-cut tests were not repeated on this development build; prior stable qualification is separate evidence. No new functionality or settings migration is introduced. No firmware installs automatically when selecting a channel.
